pay_cost_of_living_007.answer: 4% restoration plus any state-funded COLA percentage for 2006-2007, applied to teachers and psychologists.
pay_cost_of_living_007.evidence: For school year 2006-2007 the teachers’ and psychologists’ salary schedule shall be increased (restored) 4% (four percent)... In addition, the 2006-2007 will be increased by the same percentage as any funded COLA provided by the state to the base revenue limit per ADA received by the District during the 2004-2005 and 2005-2006 school years.

pay_extra_duty_schedule_008.evidence: Article VII, Section 7.7 provides an 'Extra Service Assignments and Remuneration' schedule detailing factor bases and percentage tables for Department Chairpersons, Athletics, and Co-Curricular Assignments.

pay_hardtostaff_other_011.evidence: Section 7.7.2.1 references 'bilingual stipends' as being paid monthly, though specific amounts or schedules are not detailed in this section.
